items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And I played with Buck Banville there, the American League.

ctx.x: I remember who you were talking about again. I heard of him. I'll ask Raymond Burke about it. I think Raymond thought about him. Wiffle Rogers. Yeah, we used to call him Wiffle.
Which one was Stew Meat Rogers? Yeah, Stew Meat. He's a good one. Same guy? It's a Nipper's Buck. Yeah. It's either Buck or Nipper.
Yeah. Well, maybe I got a picture up in here. Yeah. Keep talking, I'll find a picture.
